milestones.name: Original unmodified reference
milestones.evidence: Client/server binary hashes recorded; pristine version-matched assets and reproducible full-game reference traces remain unverified.

milestones.name: Trustworthy interfaces and object layouts
milestones.evidence: Function indexes, vtables and selected calling conventions recovered; full engine interfaces, field ownership, globals and indirect calls remain incomplete.

milestones.name: Complete AI reconstruction
milestones.evidence: Selected interpreter, bailout, collision and artillery routines compile from C and pass focused comparisons; scheduling, pathfinding, full target selection, aiming and lifecycle remain native.

milestones.name: Complete gameplay and physics reconstruction
milestones.evidence: No complete source-owned gameplay or physics subsystem has been validated against the original.

milestones.name: Complete multiplayer reconstruction
milestones.evidence: Original networking remains in the partial builds; source-owned protocol, replication and client/server compatibility are not established.

milestones.name: Source-owned engine and standalone build
milestones.evidence: Replacement C payload builds and executes in original executable copies; startup, rendering, audio, resources and most engine services still require original executable code.

milestones.name: Verified original-game parity
milestones.evidence: Focused original/reconstructed comparisons and live vector exception checks pass; complete vanilla gameplay, physics, AI, rendering, audio and network parity remain unverified.

definition_of_100_percent: All seven ROADMAP acceptance milestones complete: trustworthy original reference and interfaces, fully reconstructed AI, gameplay/physics and multiplayer, source-owned engine services and standalone build, and documented original-game parity.
counting_rule: Each full-project acceptance milestone counts equally and only when all of its acceptance requirements are met. Partial work is recorded but does not count as a completed milestone.
limitations: This is a coarse whole-project acceptance tracker, not an estimate of work already performed or remaining effort. Zero completed milestones does not mean no source has been recovered. Milestones differ in size; partial work cannot support a defensible precise whole-game decompilation percentage.

source_inventory.limitations: Secondary inventory statistics only, not whole-project progress. Native functions differ in complexity, boundaries remain disputed, and original service dependencies remain.
